questions.stem: Which statement regarding non-communicable diseases (NCDs) is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: NCDs are responsible for the least number of deaths worldwide.

options.label: B
options.text: Primordial prevention of NCDs involves early diagnosis and treatment of disease.

options.label: C
options.text: According to the WHO, chronic NCDs have a duration of over three months

options.label: D
options.text: Cardiovascular diseases contribute the least to the global DALY.
